rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Stuttaford Van Lines
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2008).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2008 as 'Stuttaford Van Lines'.
rows.Bloom: Cream to apricot, pink shading. None / no fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
